CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING OF THE
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMITTEE
  CORONAVRIUS (COVID-19) ADVISORY NOTICE
Consistent with Executive Orders No. N-29-20 and No. N-35-20 from the Executive Department of the
State of California and the County of Los Angeles Department of Public Health Safer at Home Order,
the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee will not be physically open to the public and
will take place via video conference.
To watch and listen to the meeting: To maximize public safety while still maintaining transparency
and public access, members of the public can participate by using Zoom Meeting as follows:
https://zoom.us/j/93289734779?pwd=aXQ1dUJnZmtaVEpKL29pMllVTXlJZz09 with Meeting ID: 932 8973
4779 and Passcode: 224099.

Zoom Meeting direct link: https://zoom.us/j/93289734779?pwd=aXQ1dUJnZmtaVEpKL29pMllVTXlJZz09
For those wishing to speak on an agenda item, please e-mail Kelsey Rivadeneyra at
kelsey@cityofalhambra.org prior to the meeting with the item number you wish to speak on and your
name. You should then join into the meeting using Meeting ID: 932 8973 4779, and Passcode:
224099, or US Toll-free, 833 548 0282 US Toll-free, 877 853 5257 US Toll-free, 888 475 4499 US
Toll-free 10 minutes prior to its start time. Ms. Rivadeneyra will announce to you when it is your time
to speak. You will have five minutes to speak, unless that time is adjusted by the President.
As an alternative you can e-mail your comments by sending them to kelsey@cityofalhambra.org no
later than 5:00 P.M. on July 21, 2021 to ensure that it will be printed prior to the beginning of the
meeting. Comments will then be read into the record, with a maximum allowance of 5 minutes per
individual comment, subject to the President’s discretion. If a comment is received after 5:00 P.M. but
before the conclusion of the meeting based on its time stamp, the comment will still be included as a
part of the record of the meeting but will not be read into the record.
Any member of the public who needs accommodations or who needs their comments translated should
e-mail or call Kelsey Rivadeneyra at kelsey@cityofalhambra.org or (626) 570-5044 who will use their
best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations to provide as much accessibility as possible while
also maintaining public safety. Given the challenges of video conference meetings, all participants are
encouraged to e-mail their comments prior to the beginning of the meeting.
  KELSEY RIVADENEYRA

  CLERICAL ASSISTANT II

Unofficial until adopted by the  August 18, 2021
City Arts and Cultural Events Committee  Action Item III
  APPROVE

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMITTEE
  Wednesday, July 21, 2021
  7:00 P.M.

The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Committee was called to order at 7:03
P.M. on Wednesday, July 21, 2021, at Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street Alhambra, via
Video Conference Zoom.

ROLL CALL
Committee Members Present: Canseco-Chan, Sanchez, and Jimenez.
Committee Members Absent: None.
Also attending: Director Michael Macias, Deputy Director Brie Houghton, and Clerical Assistant
II Kelsey Rivadeneyra.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES FROM THE JUNE 16, 2021 C.A.C.E. MEETING
With a motion by Vice President Sanchez and a second from committee member Jimenez, the
minutes of June 16, 2021, City Arts and Cultural Events Committee meeting were unanimously
approved as written.

ALHAMBRA ART ALLEY PROJECT
The Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events committee discussed how the Alhambra Art Alley
project goal is to uplift and celebrate Alhambra through the power of the arts. Alleyways south
of Main Street will be reimagined as free, outdoor art galleries to bring creativity, beauty, and a
sense of community to Alhambra residents and visitors alike. In preparation for the proposed
project, the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events committee created a survey with the
intention to gain community feedback on art in public spaces. Committee member Jimenez
presented the survey’s first draft and Deputy Director Houghton recommended to revise the
survey with general questions instead of asking about a specific project to allow for more
answers from the community. The survey is expected to go through another round of review
before launching in September 2021.

STAFF REPORT
Deputy Director Houghton shared that the 2022 Alhambra City Hall Art Gallery calendar is open
and currently accepting artists interested in exhibiting. If committee members wanted to
recommend artists or receive further details on the process, they could contact Clerical Assistant
Rivadeneyra via e-mail or telephone.

Deputy Director Houghton discussed the upcoming October 2, 2021 Autumn Fest at Alhambra
Park and requested committee involvement as judges for the Pumpkin Decorating Contest. The
 City Arts and Cultural Events committee responded with interest and also expressed an idea of
setting up a booth for youth arts and crafts.

In regards to a possible art installation “Weaving Hope” by artist Yeu Q. Nguyen that Vice
President Sanchez shared, Houghton said that the City of Alhambra would provide the posts but
not the insurance for the artist.

PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
None.

COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
Vice President Sanchez researched neighboring cities criteria for public art and call for artists as
a reference for the Alhambra district art projects. Vice President Sanchez will share her notes to
the committee at the next meeting.

ADJOURNMENT
President Canseco-Chan moved to adjourn July 21, 2021, City Arts and Cultural Events
Committee Meeting. Seconded by Vice President Jimenez, the meeting was adjourned at 7:38 P.M.
